commercialPolicy: Preserve native 888 USD cents per contract per month and legacy Web estimates; Rock ATM fee is zero per RQ15; game fees are unspecified; no live billing authorized here.
hardwarePolicy: Develop one shared RockstarOS Core with model-specific Device Support Packages. Physical native OS, experimental Android GSI, client-only and unsupported are distinct delivery modes. Pixel candidates remain unconfirmed; BlackBerry requires exact-model unlock/vendor/recovery evidence; Apple mobile devices are client-only rather than OS-replacement targets. Linux QEMU and physical evidence remain distinct.
